name: Google One Tap
tagline: One-tap Google sign-in for shoppers, right on the cart and checkout.
glyph: <svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><circle cx='9' cy='8' r='4'/><path d='M3 21a6 6 0 0 1 12 0'/><path d='m15.5 11.5 2 2 4-4'/></svg>

screens.title: Switch it on in one page
screens.caption: Pages, timing, the product-page scroll trigger and automatic sign-in, with a status check for your Google client ID.

screens.title: Signed in without leaving the page
screens.caption: Google shows its own card; your server verifies the token and signs the shopper in. The cart and checkout stay as they were.

screens.title: Uses your Social Login client ID
screens.caption: Nothing new to register: One Tap reads the Google client ID from Social Login. Shown here with a placeholder ID.

screens.title: Find it under Settings → Others
screens.caption: Off after installation, so you can set it up first. Add ?onetap=1 to a page address to test.
